method: pdftoppm at 100 dpi; every page of both public PDFs and both private Chinese PDFs inspected at full page on 2026-10-12. The build fails on orphans, split number-unit pairs and line-initial CJK punctuation (typography_issues); all four variants pass. Latest change, a professional copy edit (summaries, current-research line, Lift and SHSI bullets; one verb, "operate directly on", across all summaries): the changed pages (English academic page 1, English internship page 1, both pages of the Chinese academic CV, Chinese internship page 1) were inspected at full page: no clipping, overlap, orphan, missing glyph or abnormal break; English academic page 2 renders byte-identical to the page reviewed before. The Chinese current-research line breaks after its first clause by design (build_cv.py replaces the first "；" with a line break).
html_visual_qa: not separately reviewed; HTML CVs are unlinked companions of the PDFs
